components.title: On-chain program
components.judge: State machine clarity, constraint correctness against the Solana security checklist (signers, has_one, PDA seeds, checked math, no init_if_needed, PDA-signed transfers), event coverage, code organisation, error-path test coverage.

components.title: Agents
components.judge: Negotiation quality and realism, route sanity (geographic order, rest days, availability), safety guardrails (LLM output validated, never signs outside allowed instructions), transcript readability, heuristic fallback completeness.

components.title: Dashboard
components.judge: Fidelity to docs/DESIGN.md (near-black surfaces, single green accent, pill buttons, compact type), clarity of threshold/deadline/state per show, live feed usefulness, explorer links, wallet buy and refund flows, phone width.

components.title: Seed world
components.judge: Realism and honest labelling of approximations, no real band names, deterministic generation, loader API ergonomics.

components.title: Docs and submission
components.judge: A judge understands the product in 60 seconds from the README; setup instructions are complete and honest; architecture, spec, plan and demo script present; no claimed features that do not exist.

components.title: Developer experience
components.judge: One-command setup and demo, scripts work on Windows and Unix, structure and naming, lockfiles committed, no secrets.
